title: runOrphans 700,000-row test exceeds its 10s per-test budget on macOS CI runners
description: Observed once so far for this specific test: CI push run 39500550123 on f08c78de (opum-ai/lore-cli), job 'lint · typecheck · test (macos-latest)' (not a required context). test/orphans.test.ts, 'a --limit raised past the total still renders all 700,000 rows without a RangeError' (about line 699) timed out at 10000ms twice within attempt 1 (13301ms on the first pass); attempt 2 (rerun of the failed job) passed. f08c78de was tracker-only over the green fae2617b, so the diff could not reach the test. It builds 700,000 tasks and renders every row with no per-test timeout override, so it sits near the default budget and a slow macOS runner tips it over. Same class as the known 10s-timeout subprocess-test flakes on CI, but this is an in-process volume test, not a subprocess one. Options: give the test an explicit larger timeout, or reduce N while still exceeding the argument-length ceiling the test exists to guard (see the comment block above it). Not started.
